card.name: Saiyan Cabba
card.skill: [Auto]  When this card attacks, you may choose 1 card from your life and add it to your hand.  If you do so, this card gains +10000 power and [Double Strike]  (This card inflicts 2 damage instead of 1 when attacking) for the duration of the turn.

qa.q: When adding cards from your Life Area to your hand with {BT1-014 Saiyan Cabba}’s auto skill, can you choose which card to add to your hand?
qa.a: You can, but you cannot look at the card beforehand.

card.name: Broly, Unrealized Ambition
card.skill:
[Auto] When you play this card from your hand and if your Leader Card is a green ≪Frieza's Army≫ card, choose 2 cards from your life and add them to your hand.
[Auto] When this card is removed from a Battle Area by a skill or KO'd, and if your Leader Card is a green ≪Frieza's Army≫ card, choose 1 or 2 cards from your life and add them to your hand, then choose up to 1 green <Broly: Br> card with an energy cost of 4 from your hand and play it.

qa.q: When this card is moved to a non-open area by an opponent’s skill, can you activate and resolve this card’s auto skill?
This card’s effect was negated by {BT1-107 Cold Bloodlust}. If it then leaves the Battle Area by your opponent’s skill, does this card’s auto skill activate and resolve?
If this card is placed under one of your opponent’s cards by your opponent’s skill, does this card’s auto skill activate and resolve?
qa.a: Yes, it activates. The master of the Battle Area prior to the card changing control becomes the master of this skill, and activates and resolves it.

qa.q: If this card is placed under one of your cards by your skill, does this card’s auto skill activate and resolve?
If your opponent gains control of this card with one of their skills, does this card’s auto skill activate and resolve?
qa.a: Yes, it activates. The master of the Battle Area prior to the card changing control becomes the master of this skill, and activates and resolves it.

qa.q: If this card is KO’d or leaves the Battle Area after your opponent gains control of it, does its auto skill activate and resolve?
qa.a: Yes, the auto skill activates. However, since your opponent is the master of the skill, your opponent activates and resolves it.

qa.q: When you are prevented from adding cards in your life to your hand by this card’s auto skill, does the “choose up to 1 green 〈Broly : Br〉 card with an energy cost of 4 from your hand and play it” skill resolve?
When this card has its power lowered by a skill, resulting in its power being lowered to 0 or lower and sent to its owner’s Drop Area, can you activate and resolve this card’s auto skill?
